### Borea v0.6.9

A patch release for StarMap 0.5.0. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Crash reports

- When the game stops while StarMap 0.5.0 loads the mods, Borea names the mod that was loading again, as it does for StarMap 0.4.

Full changelog: [v0.6.8...v0.6.9](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/compare/v0.6.8...v0.6.9)
